cards.title: PCB Design & Assembly
cards.desc: Designed and routed double-layer PCBs in Altium Designer with zero ERC/DRC violations. Hand-assembled SMD boards including IMU and power-control circuits.

cards.title: Unity Game Jams
cards.desc: Unity game-jam games, including Entitled Goose Game (UW Game Jam Fall 2024) and Bandwidth (UW Winter 2025 jam).

cards.title: VR Haptic Gloves
cards.desc: ESP32-based haptic gloves with spring-loaded potentiometers for finger position and servo-driven tactile feedback for VR emulation.

cards.title: TFOTB: The Flight of the Buffalo
cards.desc: Rare-disease connection explorer: AI reads papers, but a claim is kept only if its quote is verbatim and every name resolves to an ontology ID.

cards.title: TheCloset
cards.desc: Java/Processing desktop app for ICS4U with sign-in, profiles, user search, a chatroom, and an AIML chatbot that talks back via FreeTTS.

cards.title: Kenesis — AR Gesture Controlled Robot
cards.desc: Robot driven by hand gestures through Snap Spectacles: Lens Studio → Flask → MQTT → ROS 2 on a Jetson Nano, with a 3-DoF arm.

cards.title: LitterCaching
cards.desc: MakeUofT 2025 build: ESP32-CAM glasses running an Edge Impulse can-recognition model, plus a 3D-printed claw grabber on a PVC pole.

cards.title: One Handed Keyboard
cards.desc: Wrist-mounted keyboard for one hand: 5 buttons, sequence decoding and trie + fuzzy-search word prediction on STM32, sent over UART.

cards.title: Baseline
cards.desc: Call-fraud detector that fuses local Whisper transcripts, voice matching, deepfake-audio detection and LLM scam cues into a trust score.

cards.title: FIRST Tech Challenge — Team Devolotics
cards.desc: Lead builder and programmer for FTC team 19498 Devolotics at Worlds: drone launcher, deposit, hang, and a spline-based autonomous.

cards.title: SnapFire
cards.desc: Alarm that fires darts at you: OpenCV face detection on a Raspberry Pi aims a launcher built from salvaged Roomba motors.

cards.title: FlowTO
cards.desc: On-device digital twin of Toronto traffic on a DGX Spark: GNN demand prediction, cuGraph assignment and a Nemotron planning copilot.

cards.title: choomfie
cards.desc: Personal Discord agent that runs on the Claude Code CLI: persistent memory, personas, reminders, and voice/browser/tutor plugins.

cards.title: Decompos_It
cards.desc: Android app that labels a photographed item with ML Kit and shows how long it takes to decompose, with notes on what affects it.

cards.title: Expressive AI Robot Head
cards.desc: 12-servo robot head that runs a local speech pipeline (Silero, Whisper, llama.cpp, Zonos) and drives expressions over ROS 2.

cards.title: Trash Can Robot
cards.desc: Mobile trash can on a differential-drive base: ESP32-S3 camera + motor firmware, ROS 2 nodes on a Mac, and a parametric OpenSCAD chassis.

cards.title: component-cop
cards.desc: DevTools extension that walks a live React fiber tree to flag duplicate components, hardcoded colors, spacing drift and a11y issues.

cards.title: Robotic Arm Puppeteer
cards.desc: Teleop toolkit for an 8-DOF research arm: a <150 g exoskeleton wrist controller, multi-camera AprilTag tracking (+20% pose accuracy) and ROS 2 bridges to RViz, MuJoCo and Isaac Sim.

cards.title: Pomme
cards.desc: Autonomous fruit-picking rover: 5-DOF arm, on-device ripeness detection, lidar SLAM, and a fine-tuned model that turns commands into actions.

cards.title: TaserDerby
cards.desc: Party betting game: pick a racer in a physics sim; if it loses, the web app tells an ESP32-C3 to fire a handmade taser via a relay.

cards.title: Slothing
cards.desc: Open-source, self-hostable job-search workspace: tailored resumes and cover letters from your own documents, tracking, interview prep.

cards.title: DeadInternetTheory
cards.desc: Local-first content-agent orchestrator: research, generate and publish posts and media, with human approval gates and audit trails.

cards.title: ShoulderCupid
cards.desc: Wearable AI dating coach: ESP32-CAM glasses read vital-sign cues, Gemini drafts advice, and ElevenLabs whispers it through earbuds.

cards.title: bentOS: This Portfolio
cards.desc: This site: a static Next.js 16 + Tailwind 4 portfolio laid out as a bento tray, with project content as plain JSON.

cards.title: VentureSauce
cards.desc: Chrome side panel that checks founder claims in decks, emails and notes against SEC Form D, LinkedIn, Crunchbase and press, with sources.

cards.title: KaitenCode
cards.desc: Tauri desktop app that runs AI coding agents on a kanban board, with columns as pipeline stages that fire triggers, terminals and PRs.
